_: A first-run SEED RECIPE (group 4, 4.4): how a seed capsule of this doc_type is re-created through the application's own ops. `create` runs once with the seed's metadata; `item` runs once per atom of the capsule's sys:top → sys:next chain. `{…}` fills from the seed metadata (`title`, `project`, …), the item (`text`) or the item's atom_meta (`meta.<key>`); an empty value drops the argument, and `a|b` falls back left to right. The platform's SeedManager names no Concept Model: it reads these recipes and dispatches the ops they name.
